    10	def authorize(payment_id: str, invoice: Invoice, amount, at: datetime) -> Payment:

    18	    return payment

     8	def current_period(sub: Subscription, at: datetime) -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
     9	    """Return the [start, end) billing period of ``sub`` that contains ``at``."""
    10	    at = ensure_utc(at)
    11	    start = ensure_utc(sub.started_at)
    12	    if at < start:
    13	        raise BillingError("before_start", at.isoformat())
    14	    length = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)
    15	    n = (at - start) // length
    16	    period_start = start + n * length
    17	    return period_start, period_start + length

    10	    at = ensure_utc(at)
